body:

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC343.07

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

This appears to be a PAINT issue.
Fission yeast   mug28 is an RNA binding proteon, but not [S000002837](https://www.yeastgenome.org/search?q=S000002837&is_quick=true) ortholog. It's more closly related to  poly(A) binding protein Crp79

it doesn't appear to be in the same PANTHER family as S000002837 
in InterPro
https://www.pombase.org/gene_subset/interpro:IPR050502

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
